title: Fly Anakin Drops Hard-Hitting Single "Suppression" Ahead of Upcoming Project and US Tour with YUNGMORPHEUS
htmlContent:
Fly Anakin's new single "Suppression" is a hard-hitting track that showcases his undeniable talent as a rapper. The song is a testament to his MC skills and ability to convey his message with precision and conviction. With his signature flow and powerful delivery, Anakin unloads his grievances and observations in a raw and honest manner that leaves a lasting impact on the listener.

The track is part of Anakin's forthcoming project with Mutant Academy producer Foisey, Skinemaxxx (Side A). The project promises to be a unique and vibrant offering, full of tongue-in-cheek skits, inside jokes, and blistering raps atop Foisey's masterful production.

Following the project's release, Anakin will join YUNGMORPHEUS on a co-headlining US tour on May 31st in Atlanta. The tour will take them to six cities, including Los Angeles, San Francisco, and Brooklyn.

Fly Anakin has been described by Madlib as "one of the illest MCs," and his previous collaborations with Freddie Gibbs and Pink Siifu have been critically acclaimed. With "Suppression," he proves that he is a force to be reckoned with in the rap game and a rising star to watch out for in the future.
